description:
FILED s523 (Fable, 2026-10-20 21:4x) from #3526's discriminator: `PCL_CONTAINER_BASE=ubuntu:22.04 SBCL_VERSION=2.5.2 prove -v tools/t/install-container.t` at 8038fac6 FAILS leg (a) (review/install-container-2204.log; image pcl-install-base:8c077eb25da6 now cached, so a re-run costs ~30 s per leg) while ubuntu:24.04 / SBCL 2.6.0 passes at 8038fac6 AND at aff112d7.  THE MESSAGE (the verify.sh gzip step, `use Compress::Zlib` -> IO::Compress::Gzip::Constants' `use constant GZIP_MINIMUM_HEADER => pack("C4 V C C", ...)` -> the FIRST `pack` call loads the pack extension, which COMPILES cl/pcl-pack.lisp): `While evaluating the form starting at line 1301 of /root/.local/lib/pcl/cl/pcl-pack.lisp` (= `(p-sub pl-_pack_template_size ...)`): `Unhandled simple-error: sb-vm::move-double-float-arg is not the name of a defined VOP.` from `(SB-C::VOP-PARSE-OR-LOSE SB-VM::MOVE-DOUBLE-FLOAT-ARG)`.  That VOP name is nowhere in PCL's sources (grep cl/ Pl/ tools/ lib/ = nothing): SBCL 2.5.2's compiler ASKS for it itself when some shape in the emitted form needs a double-float argument move the 2.5.2 x86-64 backend does not define (2.6.0 does) -- a declaration or a call shape the compiler sees in that p-sub (candidates: a `(the double-float ...)` / `(declare (type double-float ...))` in the RUNTIME's macros the form expands into -- the raw-numeric Kind-A emission, `%p-const-cell`, `p-pack`'s typed helpers, the s517a stable booleans -- NOT in the artifact text itself: `git diff b91b8867 9452c5db -- cl/pcl-pack.lisp cl/pcl-runtime.lisp | grep double-float` is EMPTY).  WINDOW: the install matrix was green on 2026-10-12 (b91b8867, artifacts at v2-5884) and red on 2026-10-17 08:00 UTC (9452c5db, artifacts at cf39a4cc's v2-6484, s517b) -- the emission / macro change is one of s516a, s516b, s517a (#3242 stable booleans, #1747, #3263, #3324), s517b (#3340 glob hash, zlib), s517c (#3221 print-join topic loop).  RECIPE (no SBCL 2.5.2 on the box; the container has it): `podman run --rm -v <TREE>:/pcl:ro -v packmin.pl:/packmin.pl:ro -e PATH=/opt/pcldeps/sbcl/bin:/usr/bin:/bin -e HOME=/root -e PCL_NO_CORE=1 -w /pcl pcl-install-base:8c077eb25da6 ./runpcl /packmin.pl` where packmin.pl = `print pack("C", 65), "\n";` (one step ~1-2 min; `git archive <sha> | tar -x -C <TREE>` per step; bisect over the window, then `git diff` the two neighbours' cl/pcl-runtime.lisp macros for what the failing p-sub expands into; SBCL 2.5.2's `(sb-c::vop-parse-or-lose ...)` caller frame names the IR1 shape).  Fable's first two measurements (review/sbcl252-head.log, review/sbcl252-b91b8867.log) are the window's two ends.  CONSEQUENCE: the SUPPORTED FLOOR (CLAUDE.md Dependencies: SBCL 2.5.2+, validated by the install matrix's 22.04 + debian:12 legs) is broken for every program that calls `pack` / `unpack` (the pack artifact) -- `Pl/t/pack-*.t` would all die on 2.5.2.  Fix at the EMISSION or MACRO that produces the shape (keep 2.5.2 as the floor -- the USER's portability bar; raising the floor is a USER decision), with the container recipe as the guard until an SBCL 2.5.2 is on the box (deps.sh can install one beside 2.6.0 -- consider `tools/t/sbcl-floor.t` that runs the gate's pack rows under a second SBCL when `PCL_SBCL_FLOOR=/path/sbcl` is set).  Parent: #3526 (the install-matrix red).  Not yet scheduled: the next brief after s523a (or a filler for whichever agent finishes first).

WINDOW CORRECTED (s523, 21:5x): the one-line `print pack("C", 65)` under SBCL 2.5.2 (the 22.04 container, PCL_NO_CORE=1, the tree mounted) dies with the SAME VOP error at TODAY's tree (review/sbcl252-head.log) AND at b91b8867 (review/sbcl252-b91b8867.log) -- the 2026-10-12 install-matrix run was green only because the recipe had NO pack call before s517b's gzip verify step.  So the floor has been broken for an UNKNOWN time since it was last validated (CLAUDE.md Dependencies: the full suite passed on 2.5.2 as the dev env until 2026-05-31); non-pack programs run on 2.5.2 (the container legs b/c: `use List::Util; sum(1..3)` prints 6).  Bisect start: the tree at 2026-05-31, then halving (each step ~1-2 min with the recipe above; the artifact and the runtime move together per step, so a step is a whole tree).  First cheap narrowing: run the same probe with `PCL_OPT=none` (the general-form compiler; is it the raw-numeric Kind-A emission?) and with the artifact regenerated under PCL_OPT=none -- if 2.5.2 compiles that, the shape is a Kind-A typed emission in the pack artifact.
subject: SBCL 2.5.2 FLOOR BROKEN: compiling the pack artifact (cl/pcl-pack.lisp, `pl-_pack_template_size`) under SBCL 2.5.2 dies `sb-vm::move-double-float-arg is not the name of a defined VOP` -- every `pack` call on ubuntu:22.04 / debian:12 (the install matrix's 2.5.2 images) dies; green on 2026-10-12 (gen v2-5884), red from 2026-10-17 (gen v2-6484)
